exposure.needed: whether the environment's Karpenter scheduling ever hit the intermittent nodepool-readiness flake (intermittent runtime behavior, not visible in any static configuration)

consequence.statement: After upgrading to v1.0.0, Karpenter scheduling no longer intermittently flakes due to nodepool readiness; environments that experienced the flake see it resolved.
consequence.remediation: None required; the fix ships with the upgrade.

assertion.statement: Karpenter v1.0.0 fixes an intermittent scheduling flake caused by nodepool readiness handling (PR #6491), changing scheduling behavior with no configuration change on the operator side.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: the release note names only the bug ('scheduling flake due to nodepool readiness'); it identifies no field, Helm value, flag, image, or other addressable subject that was changed
